name: Bassoon
sloganZH: 木管里最深的一口气，藏在簧片里。
sloganEN: The deepest breath in the woodwinds, kept inside a reed.

name: Clarinet
sloganZH: 一根簧片，把呼吸削成月光。
sloganEN: One reed, paring breath into moonlight.

name: Flute
sloganZH: 气息穿过银色的空，只留下一条线。
sloganEN: Breath walks through silver emptiness and leaves a single line.

name: Horn
sloganZH: 金属学着人声，慢慢变暖。
sloganEN: Metal learning a human voice, warming as it learns.

name: Oboe
sloganZH: 芦苇的疼，被吹成清亮的刀口。
sloganEN: The reed's ache, blown into a bright edge.

name: Recorder
sloganZH: 一支木管，从教堂的窗格漏下来。
sloganEN: A wooden pipe, leaking through the church window.

name: Trombone
sloganZH: 滑管推出去，低音就有了重量。
sloganEN: Push the slide, and the low end gains weight.

name: Trumpet
sloganZH: 一声竖直的亮，把屋顶掀开。
sloganEN: A vertical brightness that lifts the roof.

name: Saxophone
sloganZH: 锥形的管，装着城市的夜。
sloganEN: A conical tube holding the city's night.

name: Cornett
sloganZH: 木头做成的小号，吹出文艺复兴的尖顶。
sloganEN: A trumpet carved from wood, sounding the Renaissance spire.

name: Tuba
sloganZH: 低到能当地基，声音是石头做的。
sloganEN: So low it serves as foundation; its voice is made of stone.

name: Serpent
sloganZH: 一条皮包骨的蛇，爬过教堂的低音。
sloganEN: A serpent of leather and bone, crawling through the church bass.

name: Organ
sloganZH: 整座教堂，从一根管子开始呼吸。
sloganEN: A whole church, breathing through one pipe.

name: Timpani
sloganZH: 皮面上的雷，被调成一个音。
sloganEN: Thunder on skin, tuned to a single pitch.

name: Bass Drum
sloganZH: 心跳放平在地上，谁都得跟着走。
sloganEN: A heartbeat laid on the floor; everyone must follow.

name: Snare Drum
sloganZH: 两根槌，一场急雨。
sloganEN: Two sticks, one sudden rain.

name: Tom-tom
sloganZH: 没有音高的雷，滚过去就散了。
sloganEN: Pitchless thunder that rolls past and is gone.

name: Bongos
sloganZH: 手掌大的鼓，装着热带的急。
sloganEN: Drums the size of a palm, holding a tropical hurry.

name: Cymbal
sloganZH: 两片金属一撞，光被劈开。
sloganEN: Two metals strike, and the light splits.

name: Triangle
sloganZH: 最小的金属，最长的一声。
sloganEN: The smallest metal, the longest ring.

name: Tam-tam
sloganZH: 敲一记，然后让余音自己走完。
sloganEN: One stroke, then let the tail walk it out.

name: Castanets
sloganZH: 两块木头，替身体说话。
sloganEN: Two pieces of wood speaking for the body.

name: Glockenspiel
sloganZH: 星星落在钢条上，还没学会变暗。
sloganEN: Stars landed on steel bars and never learned to darken.

name: Xylophone
sloganZH: 木头也会发亮，只要敲得够快。
sloganEN: Wood can shine too, if struck fast enough.

name: Vibraphone
sloganZH: 金属学会了呼吸，音就活了。
sloganEN: Metal learned to breathe, and the note came alive.

name: Marimba
sloganZH: 木头的低音，带着雨林的湿。
sloganEN: A wooden bass, still damp from the rainforest.

name: Contrabassoon
sloganZH: 巴松再往下走一步，听见了地板。
sloganEN: The bassoon takes one step lower and hears the floor.

name: Bass Clarinet
sloganZH: 单簧管的影子，也学会了唱歌。
sloganEN: The clarinet's shadow, taught to sing.

name: Contrabass Clarinet
sloganZH: 暗到几乎不属于管弦乐。
sloganEN: So dark it almost refuses the orchestra.

name: Sopranino Clarinet
sloganZH: 单簧管踮起脚，声音细成一根丝。
sloganEN: The clarinet on tiptoe, thinning to a thread.

name: Soprano Clarinet
sloganZH: 单簧管本来的尺寸，其余都是对它的加减。
sloganEN: The clarinet at its own size; everything else is an adjustment.

name: Piccolo
sloganZH: 长笛丢掉了低处，只剩一线高。
sloganEN: The flute dropped its low end and kept one high thread.

name: Transverse Flute
sloganZH: 巴洛克的那一支，木头还没有变成银。
sloganEN: The Baroque one, before wood turned to silver.

name: Natural Horn
sloganZH: 没有活塞，只有泛音和一只手。
sloganEN: No valves: only overtones and one hand.

name: English Horn
sloganZH: 双簧管走低五度，声音染上暮色。
sloganEN: The oboe a fifth lower, its voice stained with dusk.

name: Oboe d'Amore
sloganZH: 名字里就有爱，音色还要更软。
sloganEN: Love is already in the name; the tone softer still.

name: Alto Trombone
sloganZH: 长号站高一点，线条更清。
sloganEN: The trombone standing higher, its line clearer.

name: Bass Trombone
sloganZH: 同一副滑管，只管往下沉。
sloganEN: The same slide, only sinking.

name: Natural Trumpet
sloganZH: 只有泛音，所以每一个音都算数。
sloganEN: Overtones only, so every note counts.

name: Cornet
sloganZH: 小号换了一张圆润的嘴，把锋利收起来。
sloganEN: The trumpet with a rounder mouth; the edge put away.

name: Bass Viol
sloganZH: 六根弦，有品，比提琴更早。
sloganEN: Six strings, fretted, older than the violin.

name: Violin
sloganZH: 四根弦，把人声拉成一条向上的线。
sloganEN: Four strings, drawing the human voice upward.

name: Viola d'Amore
sloganZH: 共鸣弦在暗处替它回声。
sloganEN: Sympathetic strings echo for it in the dark.

name: Viola
sloganZH: 不高不低，刚好是内声部的良心。
sloganEN: Neither high nor low: the inner voice's conscience.

name: Violoncello
sloganZH: 木头贴近胸口，声音就有了体温。
sloganEN: Wood close to the chest, and the tone takes on body heat.

name: Double Bass
sloganZH: 站在最下面，替整个乐团承受重量。
sloganEN: Standing at the bottom, carrying the weight for everyone.

name: Harpsichord
sloganZH: 一根羽毛拨过去，声音不能变软。
sloganEN: A quill plucks the string; the sound cannot soften.

name: Piano
sloganZH: 一台机器，学会了模仿雨。
sloganEN: A machine that learned to imitate rain.

name: Clavichord
sloganZH: 指头压下去，弦才肯发声，最轻的琴。
sloganEN: The string answers only under finger pressure: the quietest keyboard.

name: Celesta
sloganZH: 键盘下面不是弦，是一片会唱的钢。
sloganEN: Under the keys, no strings — only steel that sings.

name: Fortepiano
sloganZH: 又能响又能轻，钢琴第一次有了表情。
sloganEN: Loud and soft in one instrument: the piano's first face.
